sa: समालिङ्गय सुतानन्ये पितॄन् भ्रातृनथापरे। त्यक्तं न शेकुः स्नेहेन तत्रैव निधनं गताः॥
en: Some died calmly within the forest clasping their children and some their parents and brothers; they were unable to abandon those that were dear to them out of excessive affection.

sa: भ्रातृनभ्यगमद् विद्वान् पार्थेन सहितो बली। भ्रातृभिः पञ्चभिः कृष्णो वृतः शक्र इवामरैः॥
en: The learned and heroic (Krishna) then went with Partha (Arjuna) to his (other) cousins (the Pandavas). Surrounded by the five brothers Krishna looked like Shakra (Indra) surrounded by the celestials.

sa: स त्वरण्यगतः प्राज्ञः पितॄणां हितकाम्यया। उवाच कन्यां याचामि तिस्रो वाचः शनैरिमाः॥
en: Having gone into the forest, the wise Rishi, moved by the desire of doing good to his ancestors, said, “I shall ask for a bride, distinctly uttering the words thrice.

sa: कच्चिछोको न मन्युर्वा त्वया प्रोत्पाद्यतेऽनघ। अपि मङ्गलहस्तश्च जनः पार्श्वे नु तिष्ठति॥
en: O sinless one, you do not surely inspire anger or create grief in another person? Do men that are capable of granting you auspicious fruits always stand at your side?

sa: अर्जुन उवाच सम्बन्धी कुरुवीराणां दुपदो राजसत्तमः। मा वधीस्तद्बलं भीम गुरुदानं प्रदीयताम्॥
en: Arjuna said : This best of kings Drupada is a relative of the Kuru heroes. Therefore, O Bhima, do no: kill his soldiers. Let us only give out preceptor's remuneration.

sa: राजत्वे तं प्रजाः सर्वा धर्मज्ञ इति वव्रिरे। तस्य नाम्नाभिविख्यातं पृथिव्यां कुरुजाङ्गलम्॥
en: As Kuru was greatly virtuous, he was installed as the king by all the people. It is after his name that Kuru Jangala has become so famous in the world.

sa: स राजा तादृशोऽप्यासीद्धर्मे वीर्ये च निष्ठितः। बुद्ध्या च परमोदारो बाह्लीकेशो महायशाः॥
en: And albeit so very powerful the highly illustrious king of Vālhika never swerved from the path of morality nor neglected his deities and rather intelligently used to administer all business.

sa: निहताश्च हि ते सर्वे परिभूतास्तृणं यथा। भूताश्चैव भविष्याश्च यूयं च पुरुषाधमाः॥
en: You are all vile men; I have slain and defeated all of your family that have passed away and shall destroy all that are living and shall come into existence.

sa: पाण्डुरुवाच ममाप्येष सदा माद्रि हृद्यर्थः परिवर्तते। न तु त्वां प्रसहे वक्तुमिष्टानिष्टविवक्षया॥
en: Pandu said: O Madri, I have often, reflected over this matter in my own mind. But I hesitated to tell you, not knowing whether you would like it or not.

sa: उभौ कट्यां सुपार्श्वे तु तक्षवन्तौ च शिक्षितौ। अधोहस्तं स्वकण्द्दे तूदरस्योरसि चाक्षिपत्॥
en: Both the heroes were greatly accomplished in wrestling; each clasping the other with arms and each dragging the other to himself, they began to press each other with great force.

sa: यदाश्रौषं भीष्ममत्यन्तशूरं हतं पार्थेनाहवेष्वप्रधृष्यम्। शिखण्डिनं पुरतः स्थापयित्वा तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Arjuna, having placed Shikhandin before him on his chariot, had wounded the infinitely courageous and the unconquerable Bhishma.

sa: षट्सूर्येवाभवत्पृथ्वी पाण्डवैः सत्यविक्रमः। ततो निमित्ते कस्मिंश्चिद्धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥ वनं प्रस्थापयामास तेजस्वी सत्यविक्रमः। प्राणेभ्योऽपि प्रियतरं भ्रातरं सव्यसाचिनम्॥
en: And the earth appeared to have six suns on account of the presence of the heroic Pandavas. Then for the just king Yudhishthira sent to the forest his greatly powerful and heroic brother Savyasachin (Arjuna), dearer to him than life itself.

sa: । सत्यवत्युवाच विद्धि मां भगवन्कन्यां सदा पितृवशानुगाम्। त्वत्संयोगाच्च दुष्येत कन्याभावो ममानघ॥
en: Satyavati said : O holy Rishi, know me to be a girl under the control of my father, O sinless man, my virginity will be sullied by accepting your embraces.

sa: अन्नवान्दक्षिणावांश्च सर्वैः समुदितो गुणैः। युधिष्ठिरेण संप्राप्तोराजसूयो महाक्रतुः॥ सुनयाद्वासुदेवस्य भीमार्जुनबलेन च। घातयित्वा जरासन्धं चैद्यं च बलगर्वितम्॥
en: After killing Jarasandha, proud of his prowess through the wise counsel of Krishna and by the prowess of Bhima and Arjuna, Yudhishthira acquired the right to perform the Rajasuya which abounded in provisions and offerings and was full of transcendent merits.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्माद् देशादतिक्रान्ते ज्वलने जरिता पुनः। जगाम पुत्रकानेव त्वरिता पुत्रगृद्धिनी॥
en: Vaishampayana said : After Agni has left the place where the Sharangakas lives, Jarita, very much attached to her sons, came with all speed to see how they all were.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच आश्रमस्था ततः पुत्रमदृश्यन्ती व्यजायता शक्तेः कुलकरं राजन् द्वितीयमिव शक्तिनम्॥
en: The Gandharva said : o king, residing in the hermitage, Adrishyanti gave birth to a son who was the perpetuator of Shakti's race and who was like a second Shakti.

sa: अस्माभिः खाण्डवप्रस्थे युष्मद्वासोऽनुचिन्तितः। तस्माज्जनपदोपेतं सुविभक्तमहापथम्॥ वासाय खाण्डवप्रस्थं व्रजध्वं गतमत्सराः। तयोस्ते वचनाज्जग्मुः सह सर्वैः सुहृज्जनैः॥ नगरं खाण्डवप्रस्थं रत्नान्यादाय सर्वशः। तत्र ते न्यवसन्पार्थाः संवत्सरगणान्बहून्॥
en: We have settled that Khandavaprastha will be your abode. Therefore, casting of all jealousies go to live at Khandavaprastha, which contains many towns and broad roads, “Having heard these words, they (the Pandavas), with all their friends and followers, went to Khandavaprastha, taking with them many jewels and precious stones. And the sons of Pritha lived there for many years.

sa: कृत्वा धनुषि ते मार्गान् स्थचर्यासु चासकृत्। गजपृष्ठेऽश्वपृष्ठे च नियुद्धे च महाबलः॥
en: After repeatedly displaying their skill and dexterity in the use of bow and arrows, in the management of cars, in the fight on horseback and on the back of elephants.

sa: हीनस्य करणैः सर्वैरुच्छ्वासपरमस्य च। यतमानोऽपि तद् राज्यं न शशाकेति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: We have heard that with all his endeavours he did not succeed to get the kingdom, although the king did not look to his affairs and only breathed the air.

sa: द्विजेन्द्र यद्विषं हन्या मम वा मद्विधस्य वा। कं त्वमर्थमभिप्रेप्सुर्यासि तत्र तपोधन॥
en: That you should destroy my poison or the poison of others like me. O king of Brahmanas, O Rishi, wishing to gain what wealth, are you bent on going there?

sa: कृते विवाहे च ततस्तु पाण्डवाः। प्रभूतरत्नामुपलभ्यं तां श्रियम्। विजहरिन्द्रप्रतिमा महाबलाः पुरे च पाञ्चालनृपस्य तस्य ह॥
en: When the wedding was over and after they had obtained that maiden, like Lakshmi herself, along with great wealth, those greatly powerful sons of Pandu like so many Indras passed their days in joy, in the capital of the Panchala king.

sa: किं हि वित्तेन नः कार्यं स्वर्गेप्सूनां द्विजोत्तम। यदस्माकं धनाध्यक्षः प्रभूतं धनमाहरत्॥
en: O best of the twice born, of what use could wealth be to us who were desirous of obtaining heaven? Our treasurer (in heaven) has kept large treasures for us.

sa: रेतोधाः पुत्र उन्नयति नरदेव यमक्षयात्। त्वं चास्य धाता गर्भस्य सत्यमाह शकुन्तला॥
en: "O best of men, the son, begotten by one's own self, rescues him from the abode of Yama. You are the father of this son. Shakuntala has spoken the truth."

sa: क्षत्तरानय गच्छैतान् सह मात्रा सुसत्कृतान्। तया च देवरूपिण्या कृष्णया सह भारत॥
en: O Kshatta, go and in due affectionate way, bring them (the Pandavas) here along with their mother. O descendant of Bharata, bring also with them Krishna (Draupadi) of celestials beauty.

sa: कर्ण उवाच रङ्गोऽयं सर्वसामान्यः किमत्र तव फाल्गुन। वीर्यश्रेष्ठाश्च राजानो बलं धर्मोऽनुवर्तते॥
en: Karna said: This arena is meant for all; it is not for you alone. O Falguni, they are kings who are superior in power; Kshatriya Dharma depends on prowess alone.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शृणु राजन् पुरा सम्यङ्मया द्वैपायनाच्छुतम्। प्रोच्यमानमिदं कृत्स्नं स्ववंशजननं शुभम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, hear the auspicious history, of your own race as I recite it to you in detail and just as I heard it before from Dvaipayana.

sa: ततोऽस्य तनुजः पार्थान् कृपस्यानन्तरं प्रभुः। अस्त्राणि शिक्षयामास नाबुध्यन्त च तं जनाः॥
en: His lordly son, at the intervals of Kripa's teachings, gave instructions to the sons of Pritha (Pandavas) on the use of arms. But none knew as yet Ashvathama's (real) prowess.

sa: अज्ञातमेकं राष्ट्रे च ततो वर्षं त्रयोदशम्। ततश्चतुर्दशे वर्षे याचमानाः स्वकं वसु॥
en: And another additional year to live in concealment, thus making the period (of banishment) complete thirteen years. On the fourteenth year, when they (the Pandavas) returned and claimed their kingdom,

sa: ते तं प्रसादयामासुः सुराः सर्वेऽब्जसंभवम्। राज्ञा वासुकिना सार्धं शापोऽसौ न भवेदिति॥
en: All the celestials, with the snake-king Vasuki, tried to induce the great Deity, born of the lotus to grace in a way so that the curse might be made futile.

sa: सुखं दुःखं महद्भस्वं कर्म यत् समुपागतम्। जामदग्न्येन रामेण निर्जिताः क्षत्रिया युधि॥
en: None should consider him incapable of achieving any task that is great or little, blissful or woeful. All the Kshatriyas were defeated in battle by Rama, the son of Jamadagni.

sa: न हीदृशाः सन्त्यपरे पृथिव्यां ये योधका धार्तराष्ट्रेण लब्धाः। धर्मस्तु नित्यो मम धर्म एव महाबलः शत्रुनिबर्हणाय॥
en: There is not in the world anything equal to the warriors that have been gained by the son of Dhritarashtra on his side. Virtue is even on my side and virtue is my great strength for the destruction of my enemies.

sa: अथवा धर्ममेतं त्वं मन्यसे तपतां वर। ऋते प्रदानाद् बन्धुभ्यस्तव कामं करोम्यहम्॥
en: Or if you consider it a virtue, I will then, O best of those that shed heat, gratify your desire even without being given away to you by my friends.

sa: नात्र शङ्का त्वया कार्या प्रतीच्छेमां महाद्युते। कृतं त्वया महत् कार्यं देवानाममरप्रभ॥
en: O highly-resplendent one, O creature of divine effulgence, you need not entertain any doubt on this point. You have, (indeed) done a great service to the gods (by slaying Ravana).

sa: तमिस्र तत्र गच्छेथा गन्धर्वास्तन्न जानते। तत्र दोषः परिहतो भविष्यति न संशयः॥
en: Everywhere there surrounds darkness so, come to see me there. The Gandharvas do not know that place. No doubt, the vice too shall be removed by reason of meeting there,

sa: मनसा निश्चयं कृत्वा ततो वाचाभिधीयते। क्रियते कर्मणा पश्चात् प्रमाणं मे मनस्ततः॥
en: Having (first) settled a thing in mind, it is then expressed in words and is ultimately given effect to by (external) acts. My (own) mind is a proof of this.

sa: ते पुराणं महेष्वासा मार्गमैन्द्रं समास्थिताः। त्यक्ष्यन्ति तुमुले प्राणान् रक्षन्तः पार्थिवं यशः॥
en: They (the warriors of our party), desirous of going along the eternal, noble and heavenly path, will part with their lives in fierce battle thus keeping your earthly fame unsullied.

sa: इत्युक्तः कुपितो राजा मत्स्यः पाण्डवमब्रवीत्। समं पुत्रेण मे षण्ढं ब्रह्मबन्धो प्रशंससि॥
en: At this, being enraged, the king of Matsya's said to the son of Pandu: “O wretch of a Brahman, you speak highly of an eunuch as compared with my son.

sa: श्रीः सुखस्येह संवासः सा चापि परिपन्थिनी। ब्राह्मी सुदुर्लभा श्रीहि प्रज्ञाहीनेन क्षत्रिय॥
en: In this world, respect resides in worldly prosperity, through it is an impediment to virtue. Heavenly prosperity is not attainable by one that is devoid of (true) wisdom, O Kshatriya.

sa: अनिवृत्तेन मनसा ससर्प इव वेश्मनि। उत्सादयति यः सर्वं यशसा स विमुच्यते॥
en: Without calmness in his mind as if he lives in a house infested by snakes. He who puts an end to everything (of the enemy in battle) gets no fame.

sa: संध्येयं वर्तते रौद्रा ना रात्रिर्दिवसं न च। वृत्रश्चावश्यवध्योऽयं मम सर्वहरो रिपुः॥
en: This is evening, it is not in the sun; it is neither the night nor the day. And Vritra, the enemy who has robbed me of all must be slain.

sa: सुखं नैवेह नामुत्र लभन्ते पुरुषाधमाः। युद्धाय क्षत्रियः सृष्टः संजयेह जयाय च॥
en: The wretch does not attain to happiness in this world nor in the other, O Sanjaya; a Kshatriya has been created for fighting in this world and for gaining victories.

sa: सम्मन्त्र्य चाशु गच्छामः साधनार्थं महीपतेः। किं च नः पाण्डवैः कार्यं हीनार्थबलपौरुषैः॥
en: What business have we with the Pandavas who have been shorn of wealth, army and manliness. They have either gone away for good or repaired to the abode of Yama.

sa: शूद्रः करोति शुश्रूषां वैश्या वै पण्यजीविकाः। वयं वधेन जीवामः कपालं ब्राह्मणैर्वृतम्॥
en: A Shudra serves (the other classes); a Vaishya lives by trade and commerce; we live by massacre; and the wooden plate (profession of begging) has been selected by the Brahmanas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गावल्गणिस्तु तत्पृष्टः सभायां कुरुसंसदि। निःश्वस्य सुभृशं दीर्घ मुहुः संचिन्तयन्निव॥
en: Vaishampayana said The son of Gavalgani, being thus questioned in that council of the assembly of Kurus and having drawn long sighs, again and again became thoughtful for a moment.

sa: पूर्वे वयसि तत् कुर्याद् येन वृद्धः सुखं वसेत्। यावज्जीवेन तत् कुर्याद् येन प्रेत्य सुखं वसेत्॥
en: That act should be done during the early years of life, which will enable one to live in comfort during the old age. That act should be done in this life which will enable one to live in happiness after death.

sa: सत्यमार्जवमक्रोधः संविभागो दमः शमः।।१७। अनसूयाविहिंसा च शौचमिन्द्रियसंयमः। पावनानि महाराज नराणां पुण्यकर्मणाम्॥
en: Truth, sincerity, freedom from anger, justice, self-control, restraint of faculties, immunity from malice, guilelessness, sanctity and mortification of the senses, these, O great king, purify a man of pure acts.

sa: यत् किंचनेदं वित्तमस्यां पृथिव्यां यद् देवानां त्रिदशानां परं यत्। प्राजापत्यं त्रिदिवं ब्रह्मलोकं नाधर्मतः संजय कामयेयम्॥
en: What little wealth there is in this world, what in the possessions of the gods and what is beyond them or the region of the Prajapatis, the heaven or the region of Brahma. I do not desire even unrighteously, O Sanjaya.

sa: दिष्ट्या भवन्तः सम्प्राप्ताः सर्वे कुशलिनो वनात्। दिष्ट्या सम्पालितं कृच्छ्रमज्ञातं वै दुरात्मभिः॥
en: "By good luck, I have got you, all safe from the forest. And by good luck, it is that you spent the period of exile, undiscovered by these wicked ones.

sa: न त्वं करोषि कामेन कर्णः कारयिता तव। दुःशासनश्च पापात्मा शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः॥
en: You do not act in this way of your own will; but Karna leads you to it and Dushasana and the wicked-souled Shakuni and the son of Subala (lead you).

sa: यद्येवैष्यति सायाह्ने यदि प्रातरथो निशि। यद्यर्धरात्रे भगवान् न मे कोपं करिष्यति॥
en: He will never have any cause to be angry with me whether the worshipful one comes in the morning or in the evening or during the night or at midnight.

sa: न कुलं वृत्तहीनस्य प्रमाणमिति मे मतिः। अन्तेष्वपि हि जातानां वृत्तमेव विशिष्यते॥
en: It is my opinion that noble birth in one who is not of good behaviours dose not mean virtue; and that good manners in one born low should command respect.

sa: वृष्ण्यन्धका एग्रसेनादयो वै कृष्णप्रणीताः सर्व एवेन्द्रकल्पाः। मनस्विनः सत्यपरायणाश्च महाबला यादवा भोगवन्तः॥
en: The kings of Vrishni and Andhaka and Ugrasena and others, led by Krishna, are all the equals of Indra and are spirited, attached to truth, of great prowess and happy.

sa: राजा विराटः सुश्रोणि दृष्ट्वा वपुरमानुषम्। विहाय मां वरारोहे गच्छेत् सर्वेण चेतसा॥
en: O you of well-shaped hips; o you girl of surpassing beauty, beholding your superhuman form, king Virata, will surely forsake me and will turn to you with his whole heart.

sa: ये च तेजस्विनी दान्ता बलवन्तोऽतिमानिनः। तेषां मां मानिनीं भार्यां सूतपुत्रः पदावधीत्॥
en: The son of a Suta has kicked me the respected wife of those who are endowed with energy, and power of self-control, and who are exceedingly mighty and highly dignified.

sa: नानर्थकं सान्त्वयति प्रतिज्ञाय ददाति च। रन्ध्र परस्य जानाति यः स मध्यमपूरुषः॥
en: He who does not seek to solace another by telling untruth and who having promised performs and who knows the weakness of others, is a man of the middling type.

sa: तं तु वज्रहतं दृष्ट्वा शयानमचलोपमम्। न शर्म लेभे देवेन्द्रो दीपितस्तस्य तेजसा॥
en: Seeing him struck by the thunderbolt and lying like a mountain, the chief among the gods got no peace of mind, owing to his luster which still retained its effulgence.

sa: युध्यन्तां कामतो योधा नाहं योत्स्ये धनंजयम्। मत्स्यो ह्यस्माभिरायोध्यो यद्यागच्छेद् गवां पदम्॥२८।
en: Let any one else, if he likes, fight, I shall not fight with Dhananjaya. We shall fight with the king of Matsya's if he comes following the track of kine.

sa: यक्ष उवाच किंस्विदात्मा मनुष्यस्य किंस्विद् दैवकृतः सखा। उपजीवनं किंस्विदस्य किंस्विदस्य परायणम्॥
en: The Yaksha asked What is the soul of a man? Who is that friend given to him by Destiny? What is his chief support and what is his best refuge?

sa: कृष्ण उवाच यथार्हति भवान् वक्तुमस्मिन् काले झुपस्थिते। तथेदमर्थवद् वाक्यमुक्तं ते भरतर्षभ॥
en: Krishna said By you, O best among the race of Bharatas, have these words pregnant with meaning been said, which indeed are proper in these circumstances which have presented themselves.

sa: अथ द्वैगुण्यमीहायां फलं भवति वा न वा। यस्य प्रागेव विदिता सर्वार्थानामनित्यता॥
en: To those who make attempts there are two results, namely success or failure. He, to whom is know from the very first the uncertainly of the result of all actions,

sa: तस्या रूपेण वेषेण श्लक्ष्णया च तथा गिरा। न श्रद्दधत तां दासीमन्नहेतोरूपस्थिताम्॥
en: The people, seeing her beauty and dress, hearing her voice so sweet, could not believe her to be in a position of a maid servant come in quest of livelihood.

sa: अविजानत्सु मूढेषु निर्मर्यादेषु माधव। न त्वं वाक्यं ब्रुवन् युक्तचाण्डालेषु द्विजो यथा॥
en: Among those fools who do not know anything and who entertain no reverence for others, O Madhava, do not speak any word as a twice-born would do among the Chandalas.

sa: मन्ये न कालं क्रोधस्य पश्यन्ति पतयस्तव। तेन त्वां नाभिधावन्ति गन्धर्वाः सूर्यवर्चसः॥
en: Me-seems your Gandharva husbands of sun-like effulgence do not consider this as a befitting opportunity of giving vent to their spleen, and therefore do not run on to your succour.

sa: अत्र गत्वा सुखस्यान्तं दुःखस्यान्तं प्रपद्यते। अत्र वृत्तो दिनकरः सुरसं क्षरते पयः॥
en: Here do men come and attain to a termination of their happiness and misery and coming here does the maker of day (the sun) pour water having a nice taste.

sa: ते चेत् पित्र्ये कर्मणि वर्तमाना आपोरन् दिष्टवशेन मृत्युम्। यथाशक्त्या पूरयन्तः स्वकर्म तदप्येषां निधनं स्यात् प्रशस्तम्॥
en: And if by the ordination of fate they should meet with death, while engaged in the work which their ancestors did, then too doing all that lies in their power towards the fulfillment of their duty their death would be praiseworthy.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तं भुक्तवन्तमाश्वस्तं निशायां विदुरोऽब्रवीत्। नेदं सम्यग् व्यवसितं केशवागमनं तव॥
en: Vaishampayana said During the night Vidura said to him after he had taken his food and refreshed himself-'O Keshava, this coming of yours is not an act well thought of.

sa: ये दधुर्न च याचेयुर्ब्रह्मण्याः सत्यवादिनः। तेषां मां मानिनी भार्यां सूतपुत्रः पदावधीत्॥
en: The son of a Suta has kicked me, the respected consort of those who are truthful, devoted to Brahmans and used to give away without asking any thing in gift.

sa: क्षमा दमश्च सत्यं च अहिंसा च युधिष्ठिर। अद्भुतश्च पुनर्लोकस्त्वयि राजन् प्रतिष्ठितः॥
en: O Yudhishthira, forgiveness, power of self-control, truth, absence of desire for harm to anybody and all other virtues, that are rare in this world, are present in you, O king.

sa: विदितं ते महाराज लोकतन्त्रं नराधिप। तस्माल्लोभकृतं किञ्चित् तव तात न विद्यते॥
en: The ways and habits of men are known to you, O great king, O lord of men and therefore, O son, never has the slightest avarice been present in you.

sa: अज्ञातवासं घोरं च वसता दुष्करं कृतम्। दुःखमेव कुतः सौख्यं भ्रष्टराज्यस्य भारत॥
en: Residence unknown and unrecognised was another great difficulty overcome by you. O son of Bharata, naught but misery attends him who has lost a kingdom. Where is happiness for him?

sa: न हृष्यत्यात्मसम्माने नावमानेन तप्यते। गाङ्गो ह्रद इवाक्षोभ्यो यः स पण्डित उच्यते॥
en: He is said be a wise man who dose not exult in honors to himself and grieves not at intuits and who remains unagitated like a lake near the Ganga.

sa: निवार्यमाणश्च कुरुप्रवीरः सर्वैः सुहृद्भियमप्यतज्ज्ञः। स दीव्यमानः प्रतिदीव्य चैनं गान्धारराजस्य सुतं मताक्षम्॥
en: This brave son of Kuru, unskillful at the game of dice, though dissuaded by all his friends, challenged this son of Gandhari, an expert in the game, to a match.

sa: तथा भीमार्जुनौ कृष्णौ स्वस्रीयौ च यमावुभौ। आसने चोपविष्टस्तु शल्यः पार्थमुवाच ह॥
en: And having done the same to Bhima and Arjuna and both the twin brothers, the sons of his sister, Shalya, who had seated himself, said to the son of Pritha:

sa: शल्य उवाच क्षिप्रमेष्यामि भद्रं ते गच्छस्व स्वपुरं नृप। परिष्वज्य तथाऽन्योन्यं शल्यदुर्योधनावुभौ॥
en: Shalya said "Soon shall I return. (In the mean time) I wish you well; O king, go to your own capital.” Then the two, Shalya and Duryodhana, embraced each other.

sa: गान्धारराजः शकुनिर्निकृत्या यदब्रवीत् द्यूतकाले स पार्थम्। पराजितो नन्दनः किं तवास्ति कृष्णया त्वं दीव्य वै याज्ञसेन्या॥
en: The king of Gandhara, Shakuni, aiso thus spoke by way of jest to the son of Pritha (Yudhishthira) at the time of playing at dice-"Your younger brother being defeated, what else have you but Krishna, the daughter of Yajnasena. Stake her.'

sa: प्रजा ऊचुः उपक्षीणाः प्रजाः सर्वा राजा भव भवाय नः। ईतीः प्रणुद भद्रं ते शान्तनोः कुलवर्धन॥
en: The subjects said All the subjects are weakened, you be our king for our good and put an end to this draught and other calamities; and it will be well with you, O son of Shantanu, O perpetuator of your race.

sa: अश्रोत्रिया ये च वसन्ति वृद्धा मनस्विनः शीलबलोपपन्नाः। आशंसन्तोऽस्माकमनुस्मरन्तो यथाशक्ति धर्ममात्रां चरन्तः॥
en: And those, who though not of good blood, are aged, spirited, endued with behaviour and strength, who remember and expect us and practise the slightest virtue, according to their means.

sa: जाग्रतो दह्यमानस्य श्रयो यदनुपश्यसि। तद् ब्रूहि त्वं हि नस्तात धर्मार्थकुशलो ह्यसि॥
en: What you consider good for a man who gets no sleep and whose body is burning, tell (me) you are versed in what is regions and what leads to profit.

sa: राजा कृतयुगस्रष्टा त्रेताया द्वापरस्य च। युगस्य च चतुर्थस्य राजा भवति कारणम्॥
en: The king is the creator or maker of the Krita Yuga, as also of the Treta and Dvapara and the king becomes the cause as well of the fourth Yuga.

sa: एवं ये कुशलं शूरं हितेप्सितमकल्मषम्। सेनापतिं प्रकुर्वन्ति ते जयन्ति रणे रिपून्॥
en: In the same way those, who appoint a skillful hero who has the good of his party at heart as the leader of the army, vanquish their enemies in battle.

sa: यदि दास्यामि ते मार्गं सैन्यस्य व्रजतोऽऽज्ञया। अन्ये व्याज्ञापयिष्यन्ति मामेवं धनुषो बलात्॥
en: If, at your command I grant you a passage for the transport of your troops, then others too, from the strength of their bows, will command me to do so.

sa: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भद्रं ते पितरौ पश्य सुव्रत। विगाढा रजनी चेयं निवृत्तश्च दिवाकरः॥
en: Get up, get up, may you be all hale, O you of good devotion, come and see your parents. The sun has long gone down and the night is deepening.

sa: पक्ष्मसम्पातजे काले नकुलेन विनाकृता। न लभामि धृति वीर साद्य जीवामि पश्यमाम्॥
en: Separated from Nakula even for the shortest period of time, taken up by a wink, I obtained no peace of mind, O hero, behold me that I am still alive.

sa: त्वमेवैको जातु पुत्रस्य राजन् वशं गत्वा सर्वलोके नरेन्द्र। कामात्मनः श्लाघनो द्युतकाले नागाः शमं पश्य विपाकमस्य॥
en: O Lord of men, you, alone of all the world having come under the influence of your headstrong son, regarded success as sure and did not prevent the dispute at the time of the game; now, see the result of this.

sa: अस्मै ववाण्यददंस्तत्र देवा दृष्ट्वा भीमं कर्म कृतं रणे तत्। दाकाशे चाप्सु च ते क्रमः स्यात्॥
en: To him the gods seeing the terrible tasks done in that battle granted boons there, saying-“When you are fighting, you will not have fatigue and there shall be no impediment in your way either in the sky or below the waters.

sa: अशक्यादेवसचिवाः पार्थाः स्युरिति यद् भवान्। मन्यते तद् भयं व्येतु भवतो राजसत्तम॥
en: You think that the sons of Pritha having the gods for their assistants are incapable of being withstood; let this fear of yours be dispelled, O you best among kings.

sa: धर्मश्चेदस्ति वार्ष्णेय यथा वागभ्यभाषता त्वं चापि तत् तथा कृष्ण सर्वं सम्पादयिष्यसि॥
en: If Dharma (Virtue) exists in this world, O scion of the Vrishni race, thus you too will be what the voice announced, O Krishna; and you will accomplish all that.

sa: चचाल च मही कृत्स्ना सागरचापि चुक्षुभे। विस्मयं परमं जग्मुः पार्थिवा भरतर्षभ॥
en: And the whole earth moved together and the waters of the sea were agitated and the rulers of the earth were struck with great wonder, O best among the Bharatas.

sa: रक्षन्तु त्वां सुराः सर्वे समेषु विषमेषु च। वेत्स्यामि त्वां विदेशेऽपि कवचेनाभिसूचितम्॥
en: And may all the gods protect you in every state whether favourable or adverse. Even in foreign countries I shall be able to recognise you on account of your coat-of-mail.

sa: आत्मनः पौरुषं चैव बलं च न समं परैः। सर्वथानार्यकमैतत् प्रशंसा स्वयमात्मनः॥
en: Regarding the manly strength of myself and the might, which are not equalled by my enemies. At all times this is a dishonourable act for a man to praise himself.

sa: रिपूणां शिरसि स्थित्वा तथा विक्रम्य चोरसि। आत्मदोषात् परिभ्रष्टः कथं वक्ष्यामि तानहम्॥
en: Having hitherto stayed over the heads of my enemies, having hitherto trod upon their breasts, I have been now degraded from my position. What shall I say to them (now)?

sa: कुले जातो बलवान् यो यशस्वी बहुश्रुतः सुखजीवी यतात्मा। धर्माधर्मी ग्रथितौ यो बिभर्ति स ह्यस्य वशादुपैति॥
en: It is through luck that one is born in a high family, is mighty, is renowned, is vastly learned, is happy in this life, tries to subdue his soul or supports virtue and vice which have a close connection between them.

sa: धर्मादिषु स्थितोऽप्येवं क्षत्रिय ब्रह्म पश्यति। वेदानां चानुपूर्येण एतद् बुद्ध्या ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: A Kshatriya, too, who practises such virtues beholds the Supreme Soul and can do the same by performing all the acts prescribed in the Vedas. Knowing this I tell you.

sa: संनियच्छति यो वेगमुत्थितं क्रोधहर्षयोः। स श्रियो भाजनं राजन् यश्चापत्सु न मुह्यति॥
en: He who restrains the force arising from anger and joy is, O king, the winner of prosperity; and he who does not lose his sense in calamities also attains prosperity.

sa: न नूनं कर्मभिः पुण्यैरश्नुते पुरुषः सुखम्। द्रौपदी चेत् तथावृत्ता नाश्नुते सुखमव्ययम्॥
en: It seems that a man does not surely get happiness as the result of his virtuous acts; for Draupadi, though of virtuous habits of life, does not get unending happiness.

sa: हत्वा त्वहं धार्तराष्ट्रान् सकर्णान् राज्यं कुरूणामवजेता समग्रम्। यद् वः कार्यं तत् कुरुध्वं यथास्वमिष्ठान् दारानात्मभोगान् भजध्वम्॥
en: Having killed the sons of Dhritarashtra along with Karna, I shall take the whole of the kingdom from the sons of Kúru. (In the mean time) do whatever work you may have and enjoy yourselves and your wives and everything sweet.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच महाकुलेभ्यः स्पृहयन्ति देवा धर्मार्थनित्याश्च बहुश्रुताश्चा पृच्छामि त्वां विदुर प्रश्नमेतं भवन्ति वै कानि महाकुलानि॥
en: Dhritarashtra said The gods prefer those born of high families, and so also those who equally recognise virtue and worldly good and those that are deeply learned. I ask you, O Vidura, this question, "Who are those born in high families?"

sa: न हि भीष्मकृपद्रोणाः सकर्णा मधुसूदन। देवैरपि युधा जेतुं शक्याः किमुत पाण्डवैः॥
en: Bhishma, Kripa and Drona, along with Karna, O slayer of Madhu, are incapable of being vanquished even by the gods, how can they be so by the sons of Pandu?

sa: अग्निवर्णो ज्वलन् धीमान् स द्विजो रथधुर्यवत्। प्रतोदेनातुदद् वाला रुक्मिणी मम पश्यतः॥
en: Highly intelligent that Brahmana shone with effulgence like fire, and struck, before, me, my youthful Rukmini, as if she were an animal born to drag the cars of human beings.

sa: प्रभाते काल्यमुत्थाय कृत्वाह्निकमरिंदमः। ऋषि समुपचक्राम गमनाय रघूत्तमः॥ अभिवाद्याब्रवीद्रामो महर्षि कुम्भसंभवम्। आपृच्छे स्वाश्रमं गन्तुं मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥
en: Having got up in the morning and performed the necessary ceremonies he approached the ascetic to bid farewell, and saluting him said: O great Rșis, I do crave for your permission to go to my own habitation. Do you permit me.

sa: ततो विदितवेद्यात्मा पाण्डवानां हिते रतः। पलायने मतिं चने कुन्त्याः पुत्रैः सहानघः॥
en: Thereupon, the sinless Vidura, whose soul was enlightened with true knowledge and who was ever devoted to the good of the Pandavas, resolved that Kunti should escape with her sons.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु राजा स तथ्यमित्यभिजज्ञिवान्। पूजयामास शर्मिष्ठां धर्मं च प्रत्यपादयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus having been addressed by Sharmishtha, the king was persuaded to believe that what she said was true. He fulfilled Sharmishtha's wishes and thus protected her virtue.

sa: कौमारमेव ते चित्तं तथैवाद्य यथा पुरा। समवेक्षस्व मघवन् बुद्धिं विन्दस्व नैष्ठिकीम्॥
en: Your mind is like that of a child. It is the same as it was before. Open your eyes, O Maghavat and acquire an understanding which is sure and true.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कथं विनष्टा भगवन्नन्धका वृष्णिभिः सह। पश्यतो वासुदेवस्य भोजाश्चैव महारथाः॥
en: Indeed, O holy one, how was it that the Andhakas along with the Vrishnis, and those great car-warriors, viz., the Bhojas, met with destruction before the very eyes of Vasudeva?

sa: असिभिः पट्टिशैः शूलैः शक्तितोमरमुद्गरैः। शिलाभिर्विविधाभिश्च कार्मुकैश्च महास्वनैः॥ शस्त्रैश्च विविधैर्दिव्यैः पावकोल्काभिरेव च। देवासुरैस्ततः सैन्यैः सर्वमासीत् समाकुलम्॥
en: The entire sky was covered by the warriors of both sides with swords, axes, lances, darts, spears and heavy clubs and rocks of various sizes and bows of loud sound and various sorts of celestial weapons and fires and burning brands.

sa: प्रार्थितः पुरुषो यश्च स निवेद्यस्त्वया मम। विमृश्याहं प्रदास्यामि वरय त्वं यथेप्सितम्॥
en: Speak of that person, to me, whom you desire (for your husband). Choose, whom you like, for your husband. I will (afterwards) on (due) deliberation give you away (to him).

sa: अथ मासे चतुर्थे तु ब्रह्मणः सुमहोत्सवः। आसीत् समृद्धो मत्स्येषु पुरुषाणां सुसम्मतः॥
en: Then in the fourth month there happened a great festival, in honor of the divine Brahma, slender in form and highly valued by people, in the city of the Matsya's.

sa: गते तु नारदे पार्थो भ्रातृभिः सह कौरवः। राजसूयं क्रतुश्रेष्ठं चिन्तयामास पार्थिवः॥
en: O descendants of Kuru, on the departure of Narada, the King (Yudhishthira), the son of Pritha, began to think with his brothers (how to perform) that best of sacrifice Rajasuya.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं ते महाबाहो यथाऽसौ चरति द्विजः। युगपच्च समेतानां कार्याणां त्वं विचक्षणः॥
en: You can see, O mighty-armed hero, how his twice-born one is careering in battle. When several tasks present themselves, you know perfectly which of them should be first attended to.

sa: सर्वभूतहिते काले सर्वभूतेप्सिते तथा। को हि विद्वान् मृगं हन्याच्चरन्तं मैथुनं वने॥
en: The intercourse is agreeable to all creatures; it is productive of good to all. What man of learning is there who kills a deer engage in intercourse in the forest?

sa: सर्वे प्रमत्ता विश्वस्ता वञ्चिताः स्म हनूमता। नहि मे जीवतो गच्छेज्जीवन्स वनगोचरः॥
en: Having been negligent and confident (in our power), we have all been deceived by Hanumān. But, I living, that ranger of woods shall not (again) go hence with his life.

sa: ब्राह्मणागम्यतां शीघ्रं यावत् परधनैषिणः॥ न दूरे ते गताः क्षुद्रास्तावद् गच्छावहे सह। यावनिवर्तयाम्यद्य चौरहस्ताद् धनं तव॥
en: Bringing the bow, he cheerfully told the Brahmana, O Brahmana, come soon, so that those wretched thieves may not go far off. I shall accompany you and restore to you your wealth that has fallen into the hands of the robbers."

sa: इति तद् वः प्रयततां कृतं पार्थेन संयुगे। मा विशङ्कीर्वचो मह्यमजेयौ कृष्णपाण्डवौ॥
en: You all assaulted Partha in battle, but he defeated all of you; do not doubt my words; Krishna and the son of Pandu are incapable of being vanquished in battle.

sa: पिता पुत्रस्य भोक्ता च पितुः पुत्रस्तथैव च। अतिक्रान्तानि भोज्यानि भविष्यन्ति युगक्षये॥
en: The father will enjoy what belongs to the son and the son what belongs to the father. At such time things forbidden by the Shastras will be enjoyed by men.

sa: स तानुवाच व्यथितो बालोऽयं सुमहाबलः॥ स्रष्टारमपि लोकानां युधि विक्रम्य नाशयेत्। न बालमुत्सहे हन्तुभिति शक्रः प्रभाषते॥
en: Thus spoke Indra to those who were afflicted, 'This child possesses great prowess. He can himself destroy (even) the creator of universe in battle with his prowess. I therefore do not dare to destory him.' Thus said Shakra again and again.

sa: तथैव कृतिनौ युद्धे यमौ यमसुताविव। कथं विजेतुं शक्यौ तौ रणे जीवितुमिच्छता॥
en: Who having the desire of living can vanquish in battle the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva), who are like the sons of Yama himself and who are both well-skilled in battle?

sa: षड्भिश्च तस्य चिच्छेद ज्वलन्तं ध्वजमुत्तमम्। छित्त्वा तं च ननादोच्चैस्तव पुत्रस्य पश्यतः॥
en: With three more arrows he cut down the excellent standard that was indeed blazing. Having severed it, he uttered a loud roar even before ihe very eyes of your son.

sa: एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व साधु चेष्टामहे तदा। कृपा मे महती जाता तस्याभ्युद्धरणेन हि॥
en: Tell me all this. We shall then try our best for him. I am stricken with pity on account of the difficulties that lie in the way of his release."

sa: अहं कि किंदमो नाम तपसा भावितो मुनिः। व्यपत्रपन्मनुष्याणां मृग्यां मैथुनमाचरम्॥ मृगो भूत्वा मृगैः सार्धं चरामि गहने वने। न तु ते ब्रह्महत्येयं भविष्यत्यविजानतः॥
en: I am an ascetic Rishi, named Kindama. I was engaged in intercourse with this deer out of shame of men. Assuming the form of a deer I roam in the deep forest in company with other female deer. The sin of killing a Brahmana, (however), will not be yours, for you have done it not knowing me (to be Brahmana).

sa: अनास्तिकानां भूतानां प्राणदाः पितरश्च ये। तेऽपि कर्मैव कुर्वन्ति विधि सम्प्रेक्ष्य पार्थिव॥
en: Observing the Vedic ordinances (of the Creator as declared in the Vedas), the Pitris, who support (by rain) the lives of even all disbelievers, are, O king, engaged in action.

sa: कुशीलवौ तु धर्मज्ञौ राजपुत्रौ यशस्विनौ। भ्रातरौ स्वरसम्पन्नौ ददर्शाश्रमवासिनौ ॥ स तु मेधाविनौ दृष्ट्वा वेदेषु परिनिष्ठितौ। वेदोपबृंहणार्थाय तावग्राहयत प्रभुः॥ काव्यं रामायणं कृत्स्नं सीतायाश्चरितं महत्। पौलस्त्यवधमित्येवं चकार चरितव्रतः।७।।
en: And he found those illustrious princes the brothers Kusi and lava, knowing morality, and living in a hermitage, and endowed with rythmic voice, well versed in the Vedas. And finding them of a retentive endowment, and initiated into Vedic studies, that lord thought them how to interpret the Vedas, and that vow-observing one taught them the great Rāmāyaṇa in full, treating of Sītā's great life, and the destruction of Paulastya (Rāvana).

sa: न तवाविदितं किंचिद् भवाञ्चतिनिधिः स्मृतः। कथ्यते देवलोके च पितृलोके च ब्राह्मण॥
en: There is nothing which you do not know. You are an ocean of the Shrutis, as described, O Brahmana, in the world of both the gods and the departed manes.

sa: न तत् पश्याम्यहं रक्षो यदस्य भयमावहेत् । निर्वृता भव नास्त्येतत् केनाप्येतदुदाहृतम्॥
en: I do not see such a Rākṣasa, as can excite his fear. Do you desist. These cries do not come from him; but must have been uttered by someone else.

sa: न कोपः पाण्डवे कार्यो गान्धारि शमभाप्नुहि! वचो निगृह्यतामेतच्छृणु चेदं वचो मम॥
en: Thou should not be angry with the Pandavas, O Gandhari! Set your heart on peace! Restrain the words that are about to drop from your lips! Listen to my advice.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु सैरन्ध्या कीचकः काममोहितः। जानन्नपि सुदुर्बुद्धिः परदाराभिमर्शने।॥ दोषान् बहून् प्राणहरान् सर्वलोकविगर्हितान्। प्रोवाचेदं सुदुर्बुद्धिद्रौपदीमजितेन्द्रियः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed by Sairandhri the wickedminded Kichaka, with senses unsubdued and overcome by lust, in spite of the knowledge of numerous evils of adultery the evils denounced by every body and sometimes ending fatally, spoke the following to Draupadi.

sa: जग्रास प्रसभं तानि सर्वाण्यस्त्राणि मे नृप। तेषु सर्वेषु जग्धेषु ब्रह्मास्त्रं महदादिशम्॥
en: But, O king, he instantly devoured all those weapons discharged by me. And when all those had been swallowed up, I aimed (at him) the weapon presided over by Brahma.

sa: सा मां हिमवतः प्रस्थे सुषुवे मनेकाप्सराः। अवकीर्य च मां याता परात्मजमिवासती॥
en: The Apsara Menaka gave me birth in a valley of the Himalayas. Devoid of affections, she went away, leaving me there, as if I was a child of some others.

sa: न कामये नरश्रेष्ठ जीवितं पृथिवीं तथा। यथा तव प्रियं राजंश्चिकीर्षामि परंतप॥
en: a state O foremost of men, I do not wish for life and the Earth! O scorcher of enemies, I shall engage myself in doing what is pleasant to you.

sa: इमे हि मे महाभाग पत्रिणस्तिग्मतेजसः। कार्तिकेयवनोद्भूताः शरा हेमविभूषिताः॥ कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छन्ना महेन्द्राशनिसंनिभाः। सुपर्वाणः सुतीक्ष्णाग्राः सरोषा भुजगा इव॥
en: O exalted one, these feathered shafts of exceeding energy, sprung from the Kārtikeya forest, decked with gold, furnished with the plumes of the Kanka, resembling the thunderbolt of the great Indra, having smooth knots, and sharp heads, are like enraged serpents.

sa: यस्मिन्नभ्यधिका वीरे गुणाः सर्वे धनंजयात्। यस्मिन्नस्त्राणि सत्यं च ब्रह्मचर्ये च सर्वदा॥
en: That most excellent hero among the Vrishnis, that foremost of all wielders of bow, that hero, in whom reside all virtues even in a greater degree than in Dhananjaya himself.

sa: ततः स तेषां पुरुषप्रवीरः शरासनार्चिः शरवेगतापः। वातं रथानामदहत् समन्युर्वनं यथाग्निः कुरुपुङ्गवानाम्॥
en: Thereupon worked up with anger that foremost of men began to consume, with blazing shafts, discharged from his bow, the cars of the leading Kurus like fire consuming the forest.

sa: प्रयाहि राजन् भद्रं ते घुष्टस्ते नगरे जयः। अध्यास्स्व चिररात्राय पितृपैतामहं पदम्॥
en: (Therefore), O monarch, do set out. May you prosper. Your restoration has been proclaimed in the city. May you for ever occupy the portion filled by your sire and grandsire."

sa: त्वं तु शस्त्रभृतां श्रेष्ठः सततं धर्मवत्सलः॥ राजा गुरुः प्राणभृतां तस्मादेतद् ब्रवीम्यहम्।
en: You are the foremost of all righteous persons. You are always devoted to virtue. The king is the preceptor of all creatures. It is for this that I say so.

sa: महोत्पातानिमान् सर्वानुत्थितान् घोरदर्शनान् ॥ न चिन्तयाम्यहं वीर्याद् बलवान् दुर्बलानिव। तारा अपि शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः पातयेयं नभस्तलात्॥ मृत्यु मरणधर्मेण संक्रुद्धो योजयाम्यहम्। राघवं तं बलोत्सिक्तं भ्रातरं चापि लक्ष्मणम्॥ अहत्वा सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नोपावर्तितुमुत्सहे।
en: Even as a strong person from prowess counts not a weak one, I do not dwell upon all these mighty portents, dreadful to behold, that have appeared. Even the stars will I bring down from heaven with my sharp shafts; and even Death will I engaged, bring to mortality. Without slaying Rāghava puffed up with pride as well as Laksmana, by means of sharp weapons, I return not (from the conflict).

sa: न चोपलभ्यते तेन न चाश्चर्याणि कुर्वते। निविण्णात्मा परोक्षो वा धिक्कृतः पूर्वसाधुषु॥
en: The person who is censured by good men, who hates good men and who hides himself from their view, never acquires any blessing and never understands the fitness of acts.

sa: न ग्लानिरासीत् कर्णस्य क्षिपतः सायकान् बहून्। रणे विनिघ्नतः शत्रून् क्रुद्धस्येव शतक्रतोः॥
en: Karna, resembling Indra himself, when he is greatly filled with wrath, felt no fatigue while he was shooting large numbers of arrows in the field of battle, slaughtering the antagonists.

sa: कर्ण उवाच तुष्यामि ते विप्रमुख्य भुजवीर्यस्य संयुगे। अविषादस्य चैवास्य शस्त्रास्त्रविजयस्य च॥
en: Karna said: O foremost of the Brahmanas, I am pleased to see the strength of your arms, that know no relaxation in battle. Your weapons are worthy of achieving victory.

sa: सन्ति क्वचिन्महादर्यो दुर्गाः काश्चिद् दुरासदाः। नातिक्रामेत पक्षी यान् कुत एवेतरे मृगाः॥
en: There are some places, where are very dangerous caves that they are perfectly inaccessible and unfit for habitation. Not to speak of other creatures, even birds can not cross them.

sa: षष्ठे काले ममाहारो विहितो द्विजसत्तम। न शक्यस्त्वं समुत्स्रष्टुं क्षुधितेन मयाद्य वै॥
en: The king said O best of Brahmanas, food has been ordained for me at the sixth hour of the day. I am hungry. I cannot, therefore, allow you escape today.

sa: कश्च जातु कुले जातः क्षत्रधर्मेण वर्तयन्। भयाद् वृत्तिं समीक्ष्यैवं प्रणमेदिह कर्हिचित्॥
en: Who is there, who born in a noble family and abiding by the rules of the Kshatriya class, seeing that his life is in danger would bow before any body?

sa: पितुर्हि समतिक्रान्तं पुत्रो यः साधु मन्यते। तदपत्यं मतं लोके विपरीतमतोऽन्यथा ॥
en: The son that repair the wrong done by his father by acting contrary to the latter is in this world considered really a son; but not he that acts otherwise.

sa: गाहमानो मया द्रोणो दिव्येनास्त्रेण संयुगे॥ विसृष्टशस्रो निहतः किं तत्र क्रूर दुष्कृतम्।
en: Arranging his troops in order Drona was fighting with his celestial weapons he laid aside his weapons and I slew him o crooked one, what is there improper in this?

sa: तिलोदकं सदा श्राद्धे मन्यन्ते पितरोऽक्षयम्। दीपे च कृसरे चैव तुष्यन्तेऽस्य पितामहाः॥
en: Gifts of water with sesame seeds are considered by the departed Manes as yielding eternal gratification to them. The grandfathers all become highly pleased with gifts of lamps and Krishara.

sa: भीष्मेण सहिताः सर्वे पुत्रैश्च तव भारत। अग्रतः सर्वसैन्यानां व्यूहस्य प्रमुखे स्थिताः॥
en: All these, O Bharata, accompanied by Bhishma, and along with your sons stationed themselves in the van of all the troops, and in the very head of the Kaurava array.

sa: नान्यत् कर्मास्ति पापीयः क्षत्रियस्य पलायनात्। न युद्धधर्माच्छेयान् हि पन्थाः स्वर्गस्य कौरवाः॥
en: There is no act more sinful for a Kshatriya than to fly away from the battle-field. You Kauravas, there is no greater path to heaven than the duty of battle.

sa: तमुवाच महाराज नकुलं जम्बुको वने। स्वबाहुबलमाश्रित्य निर्जितास्तेऽन्यतो गताः॥ मम दत्त्वा नियुद्धं त्वं भुड्क्ष्व मांसं यथेप्सितम्।
en: O great king, the jackal thus spoke to the mongoose in the forest. I have defeated others with the might of my arms and they have already fled away. Fight with me first and then eat this flesh as you please.

sa: पुण्यतीर्थाभिषेकं च पवित्राणां च कीर्तनम्। सद्भिः सम्भाषणं चैव प्रशस्तं कीर्त्यते बुधैः॥
en: The learned men have said that ablutions in the sacred Tirthas, recitations of the names of holy ones and conversations with the good and the virtuous are all praiseworthy acts.

sa: विदुरादयश्च ते सर्वे रुरुदुदुःखिता भृशम्। अतिदुःखात् तु राजानं नोचुः किंचन पाण्डवम्॥
en: Vidura and others wept aloud in great sorrow. On account, however, of thc poignancy of their sorrow, they said nothing to either the old king or the son of Pandu.

sa: कर्ण मद्वचनं तात शृणु सत्यभृतां वर। ब्रुवतोऽद्य महाबाहो सौहृदात् परमं हितम्॥
en: "O son, O Karna, O foremost of the truthful, O mighty-armed one, listen to these highly beneficial words of mine that I tell you today out of affection for you.

sa: क्व सा बुद्धिरियं चाद्य भवत्या यच्छुतं मया। क्षत्रधर्मे स्थितिं चोक्त्वा तस्याश्च्यवितुमिच्छसि॥
en: Where now is that understanding of yours about which I had heard from Vasudeva? Do you wish now to deviate from those Kshatriya practices about which you had instructed us?

sa: पक्षे पक्षे गते यस्तु भक्तमश्नशति भारत। गवाढ्यो बहुपुत्रश्च बहुभार्यः स जायते॥
en: The man who, abstaining from it every day, takes rice at the termination of every fortnight becomes possessed of a great many kine, a large progeny, and a long life.

sa: हिरण्यबिन्दुं विक्षोभ्य प्रयतश्चाभिवाद्य च॥ कुशेशयं च देव तं धूयते तस्य किल्बिषम्।
en: By bathing in the waters of Hiranyabindu with a concentrated mind and respecting that sacred river, and bathing next at Kusheshaya and Devanta, one becomes purged of all one's sins.

sa: ततः सोऽवभृथे राजा मुदितो जनमेजयः। पितरं स्नापयामास स्वयं सस्नौ च पार्थिवः॥
en: King Janamejaya performing the final both in his sacrifice, became highly pleased. He poured the sacred water on his father even as he caused it to be poured on himself.

sa: यातुधान्युवाच यथोदाहृतमेतत् ते मयि नाम महामुने। नैतद् धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम्॥
en: Yatudhani said The etymological signification you have given, O great ascetic, of your name, passes the range of my comprehension. Do you go and plunge into this lake of lotuses.

sa: मनसा च प्रदीप्तेन ब्रह्मज्ञानजलेन च। स्नाति यो मानसे तीर्थे तत्स्नानं तत्त्वदर्शिनः॥
en: Those ablutions which one performs with a burning mind in the waters of the knowledge of Brahma in the Tirtha called Manasa, are the true ablutions for truth knowing persons.

sa: वृषदर्भी उवाच ऋषीणां गच्छ सप्तनामरुन्धत्यास्तथैव च। दासीभर्तुश्च दास्याश्च मनसा नाम धारय॥
en: Vrishadarbhi said Go and follow the seven Rishis, as also Arundhati, and the husband of their maidservant, and the maid-servant herself, and understand what the meanings are of their names.

sa: बृहस्पतिरुवाच गच्छन्त्यमुत्र लोकं वै क एनमनुगच्छति। एकः प्रसूयते राजन्नेक एव विनश्यति॥
en: Brihaspati said One is born alone, o king, and one dies alone; one crosses alone the difficulties one meets with, and one alone meets whatever misery falls to his lot.

sa: भवन्ति निर्विषाः सर्प यथा तार्क्ष्यस्य दर्शनात्। गङ्गाया दर्शनात् तद्वत् सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: As snakes become shorn of their poison as soon as they see Garuda, so one becomes purged of all his sins as soon as he sees the sacred river Ganga.

sa: विश्वे चाग्निमुखा देवाः संख्याताः पूर्वमेव ते। तेषां नामानि वक्ष्यामि भागार्हाणां महात्मनाम्॥
en: The Vishvedevas, having Agni for their mouth, have been mentioned before. I shall now mention the names of those great deities who deserve shares of the offerings made at Shraddhas.

sa: कथं च स महीपालो हतपुत्रो निराश्रयः। पल्या सह वसत्येको वने श्वापदसेविते॥
en: How, indeed, is that king; whose sons have all been killed and who is without refuge, living alone, with only his wife, in the forest haunted by beasts of prey?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच वनं गते कौरवेन्द्रे दुःखशोकसमन्विताः। बभूवुः पाण्डवा राजन् मातृशोकेन चान्विताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Upon the retirement of the king of the Kurus into the forest, the Pandavas, O king, afflicted besides by grief on account of their mother, became very dispirited.

sa: विधिना वेददृष्टेन तद्भुक्त्वेह न दुष्यति। यत्रार्थ पशवः सृष्टा इत्यपि श्रूयते श्रुतिः॥ अतोऽन्यथा प्रवृत्तानां राक्षसो विधिरुच्यते।
en: One does not, however, commit any sin by eating flesh sanctified according to the ordinances to the Vedas. The Shruti says that animal were created for sacrifice. They wlio eat flesh in any other way are said to follow Rakshasa practice.

sa: तस्मान्मृत्युभयात् कीट मा व्यथिष्ठाः कथंचन।॥ धर्मलोपभयं ते स्यात् तस्माद् धर्मं चरोत्तमम्।
en: Therefore, O worm do not be troubled through fear of death. The only fear you should entertain is about the loss of virtue. Do you therefore, go on practising virtue.

sa: तत्र तीव्र व्रणं दृष्ट्वा गर्दभी पुत्रगृद्धिनी। उवाच मा शुचः पुत्र चाण्डालस्त्वधितिष्ठति॥
en: Seeing those marks of violence on her child's nose, the she-ass, full of affection for him, said, Do not grieve, O child, for this treatinent! A Chandala is driving you.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एतदाख्याय सा देवी सुमनायै तपस्विनी। पतिधर्मे महाभागा जगामादर्शनं तदा॥
en: Bhishma said The illustrious and highly blessed Shandili, of pious conduct having said these words to Sumana on the subject of woman's duties towards her husband, disappeared there and then.

sa: दृष्टिप्रदानमपि ते पाण्डवान् प्रति नो वृथा॥ समर्थास्त्रिदिवस्यापि पालने किं पुनः क्षितेः।
en: It is not necessary for either you or ourselves to look after the Pandavas. They are capable of ruling the very Heavens, what need then be said of the Earth?

sa: सनातनो हि संकल्पः काम इत्यभिधीयते। रुद्रस्य तेजः प्रस्कन्नमग्नौ निपतितं च यत्॥
en: Will is eternal. That Will is known by the name of Kama and is at one with Rudra's seed a portion of which fell into the burning form of Agni.

sa: शरणागतं ये रक्षन्ति भूतग्रामं चतुर्विधम्। किं तस्य भरतश्रेष्ठ फलं भवति तत्त्वतः॥
en: Tell me truly, O chief of Bharata's race, what the merits are of those persons who grant protection to living creatures of the four castes when these pray for protection.

sa: धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च मया जुष्टाः सुखान्विताः। एवं प्रभावं मां गावो विजानीत सुखप्रदाः॥
en: Virtue, Prosperity, and Pleasure, only when endued with me, become sources of happiness. You kine, who are givers of sources of happiness, know that I am gifted with such energy.

sa: गाव: पवित्राः पुण्याश्च पावनं परमं महत्। ताश्च दत्त्वा द्विजातिभ्यो नरः स्वर्गमुपाश्नुते॥
en: Kine are sacred. They are embodiments of virtue. They are high and most efficacious purifiers of all. By making gifts of kine to the Brahmanas one acquires the celestial region.

sa: दुह्येन मनसा वापि गोषु नित्यं सुखप्रदः। अर्चयेत सदा चैव नमस्कारैश्च पूजयेत्॥
en: One should never, even in his heart, injure, kine. One should indeed, always confer happiness on them. One should always respect kine and adore them, by bending low his head.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ब्राह्मणानेव सततं भृशं सम्परिपूजयेत्। एते हि सोमराजान ईश्वराः सुखदुःखयोः॥
en: Bhishma said One should always offer the most respectful adoration to the Brahmanas. They have Soma for their king, and they it is who confer happiness and misery upon others.

sa: न च वर्षति पर्जन्यः कथमन्नं भविष्यति॥ सत्रं चेदहं महद् विप्रा मुनेादशवार्षिकम्।
en: The deity of the clouds, however, has ceased to pour rain. How, indeed will food grow? This sacrifices of the Rishi, you Brahmanas, is great and extends for twelve years.

sa: यद् ब्राह्मणमुखात् प्राप्तं प्रतिगृह्णन्ति वै वचः। भूतात्मानो महात्मानस्ते न यान्ति पराभवम्॥
en: Those great persons indeed, those persons who have subdued their souls, who accept the words that fall from the lips of the Brahmanas, are never defeated. Victory always becomes theirs.

sa: नारद उवाच अथ व्योम्नि महाञ्छब्दः सविद्युत्स्तनयित्नुमान्। मेघैश्च गगनं नीलं संरुद्धमभवद् घनैः॥
en: Narada said At the conclusion of Mahadeva's speech, loud roars were heard in the sky. Thunders bellowed, with flashes of lightning. The sky was covered with blue and thick clouds.

sa: अत्र गाथाः पुरागीताः कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः। सृष्ट्वा द्विजातीन् धाता हि यथापूर्वं समादधत्॥
en: About it, persons conversant with ancient history repeat the following verses sung of old respecting how in ancient times the Creator, after having created the Brahmanas, laid down their duties.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य तु यो दद्याद् गाः संशुद्धेन चेतसा। तस्यापीहक्षियाल्लोकान् ध्रुवान् विद्धि शचीपते।।२०
en: That person who having acquired a cow in gift makes a gift of her with a pure heart, succeeds, forsooth, O lord of Sachi, in Obtaining eternal regions of beatitude.

sa: देहः प्राणश्च धर्मश्च शुश्रूषार्थमिदं गुरोः। तव विप्र प्रसादेन लोकान् प्राप्स्यामहे शुभान्॥
en: My body, life-breaths, and religious rites, have all one objects viz., the service of iny elder. through your favour, O learned Brahmana, I shall obtain many regions of happiness hereafter.

sa: तव प्रसादान्निर्वृत्ता मम लोकाः किलाक्षयाः। पुत्रेण तानवाप्नोति यत्र गत्वा न शोचति॥
en: Through your grace, numerous regions of beatitude will be mine for eternity Through a grandson one obtains those regions going where one has not to suffer any kind of misery.

sa: बालानां क्षुद् बलवती जानाम्येतदहं प्रभो। वृद्धोऽहं धारयिष्यामि त्वं बली भव पुत्रका६१।।
en: O powerful me, I know that the hunger of children is very strong. I am old. I shall somehow succeed in holding my life-breaths. Do you, O son, become strong.

sa: तं धर्मराजो धर्मज्ञं पूजयित्वा प्रतापवान्। कृत्वा च संविदं तेन विससर्ज यथागतम्॥
en: Endued with great energy, the judge of the dead adored that pious Brahmana, and having conversed with him for some time dismissed him for being taken back to his house.

sa: तमाक्रम्यानयामास प्रतिषिद्धो यमेन यः। तस्मै यमः समुत्थाय पूजां कृत्वा च वीर्यवान्॥
en: Attacking that person, he brought him who had been forbidden by Yama to be brought. Endued with great energy, Yama rose up on seeing the Brahmana and adored him duly.

sa: अथागम्य महाराज नमस्कृत्य च कश्यपम्। पृथिवी काश्यपी यज्ञे सुता तस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Upon the expiration of this period, the goddess returned from the region of Brahman and arrived here bowed to Kashyapa and from that time became the daughter of that Rishi.

sa: स राजा जाह्नवीतीरे यथा ते कथितं मया। तेनाग्निना समायुक्तः स्वेनैव भरतर्षभ।॥
en: United with that (sacred) fire of his own, O chief of the Bharatas, the king, as I have already said to you, met with death on the banks of Ganga.

sa: अल्पान्तरमिदं शश्वत् पुराणा मेनिरे जनाः। यो यजेताश्वमेधेन दद्याद् वा साधवे महीम्॥
en: The ancients thought that there is always very little difference between the man who celebrates a Horse-Sacrifice and him who makes a gift of earth to one who is righteous.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा तु नृपतिः प्राप्तं पितरं बभ्रुवाहनः। निर्ययौ विनयेनाथ ब्राह्मणार्थपुरःसरः॥
en: Hearing that his father Arjuna had arrived within his kingdom, the king of Manipura, Babhruvahana went out with humility, with a number of Brahmanas and some treasure in his van.

sa: युध्यध्वं परया शक्त्या यतध्वं विजये मम॥ कुरुध्वं सर्वकार्याणि महद् वो भयमागतम्।
en: Do you fight to to best of your power and do you try to defeat me. Do you, however, accomplish all necessary deeds, for a great danger awaits you all.

sa: अश्रुत्वा तस्य धीरस्य वाक्यानि मधुराण्यहम्। फलं प्राप्य महद् दुःखं निमग्नः शोकसागरे॥
en: Having paid no heed to the sweet words of that sedate one, I have obtained this powerful grief as a consequence, and have been plunged in an occan of misery.

sa: ऋत्विक्पुरोहिताचार्या मृदुब्रह्मधरा हि ते। क्षात्रेणापि हि संसृष्टं तेजः शाम्यति वै द्विजे॥
en: Ritwijas, Priests and Preceptors, when well-read in the Vedas and when behaving mildly towards disciples, become such. Forsooth, Kshatriya energy loses its force upon a Brahmana when it meets him.

sa: तस्मिन् वस्त्राणि दिव्यानि दिव्यं संहननं तथा। दिव्यं धनुश्चेषुधी च स एनमनुयास्यति॥
en: In him are all celestial weapons, His body is like that of a celestial in its powers of endurance. His bow and quivers are celestial. He will follow this horse.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आरामाणां तडागानां यत् फलं कुरुपुङ्गवा तदहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि त्वत्तोऽद्य भरतर्षभ॥
en: Yudhishthira said I wish, O Bharata, chief to hear from you what the rewards are, O best of the Kurus, of the planting of trees and the digging of tanks.

sa: तस्मै तुष्टः स शिष्याय प्रसन्नो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। सिद्धिं परामभिप्रेक्ष्य शृणु मत्तो जनार्दन॥
en: Pleased with Kashyapa, the Brahmana one day addressed him cheerfully and spoke as follows, having the highest success in view. Listen to those words, O Janardana, as I repeat them.

sa: गौतमस्त्वब्रवीत् पत्नीमुत्तको नाद्य दृश्यते। इति पृष्टा तमाचष्ट कुण्डलार्थे गतं च सा॥
en: Gautama meanwhile said to his wife —'Utanka is not to be seen today. Thus addressed, she informed him how he had gone for fetching the jewelled ear-rings (of Saudasa's queen).

sa: सौदासपल्या विधृते दिव्ये मणिकुण्डले। ते समानय भद्रं ते गुर्वर्थः सुकृतो भवेत्॥
en: Ahalya said Blessed be you, bring for me those celestial ear-rings which are worn by the wife of Saudasa. That which is due to your preceptor will then be well-discharged.

sa: उत्तङ्कस्तु महाराज पुनरेवाब्रवीद् वचः। आज्ञापयस्व मां मातः कर्तव्यं च तव प्रियम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Utanka, however, O king, once more said these words, Do you command me, O mother. It is proper that I should do something that is agreeable to you.

sa: तेषामेतेन विधिना जातानां वर्णसंकरे। को धर्मः कानि कर्माणि तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: What, O grandfather, are the duties of persons who are born in the mixed classes and what are the acts laid down for them? Do you describe them to me.

sa: द्वाविमौ पक्षिणौ नित्यौ संक्षेपौ चाप्यचेतनी। एताभ्यां तु परो योऽयश्चेतनावान् स उच्यते॥
en: These are the two birds, which are immutable, which are friends, and which should be known as unintelligent. That other who is different from these two is called the Intelligent.

sa: च्यवन उवाच नाहं शतसहस्रेण निमेयः पार्थिवर्षभ। दीयतां सदृशं मूल्यममात्यैः सह चिन्तय॥
en: Chyavana said I should not be bought with a hundred thousand coins, O best of kings! Let a proper price be given to these! Do you consult with your ministers.

sa: नवमी दशमी चास्य तथा चैकादशी वृषः। ज्याशतं शतसंघानः स कर्णो नावबुध्यते॥
en: Similarly his string was cut-off by Vrishna for the ninth, tenth and eleventh times. Although capable of discharging hundreds of arrow Karna knew that Arjuna had a century of strings.

sa: ब्राह्मणस्याभिशापेन रामस्य च महात्मनः। कुन्त्याच वरदानेन मायया च शतक्रतोः॥ भीष्मावमानात् संख्यायां रथस्यार्धानुकीर्तनात्। शल्यात् तेजोवधाच्चापि वासुदेवनयेन च॥॥ रुद्रस्य देवराजस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च। कुबेरद्रोणयोश्चैव कृपस्य च पहात्मनः॥ अस्त्राणि दिव्यान्यादाय युधि गाण्डीवधन्वना। हतो वैकर्तनः कर्णो दिवाकरसमद्युतिः॥
en: On account of a Brahmana's curse, as also of the curse of the great Rama, of the boon granted to Kunti and the illusion practised on him by Indra, of his being belittled by Bhishma as only half-a car-warrior, behind Rathas and Atirathas, of the destruction of his energy caused by Shalya, of Vasudeva's policy, and, lastly, of the celestial weapons acquired by Arjuna from Rudra and Indra and Yama and Varuna and Kuvera and Drona and the illustrious Kripa, Arjuna succeeded in killing. Vikartana's son Karna of solar effulgence.

sa: तदस्य स्याद् बलार्थ वा धनं यज्ञार्थमेव च। अभोग्याश्चौषधीश्छित्त्वा भोग्या एव पचन्त्युत॥
en: The Kshatriya should use that wealth for mairtaining his army and for the celebration of sacrifices. Tearing up useless creepers and plants, men burn them for cooking vegetables of food.

sa: वाष्पपूर्णमुखी दीना दृष्ट्वा तं रुदती सुतम्। पूजनी दुःखसंतप्ता रुदती वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ क्षत्रिये सगतं नास्ति न प्रीतिर्न च सौहृदम्। कारणात् सान्त्वयन्त्येते कृतार्थाः संत्यजन्ति च॥
en: Seeing her son dead, Pujani, with tears trickling down her cheeks, and heart burning with grief, wept bitterly and said,-Alas nobody should live with a Kshatriya or contract friendship with him, or take pleasure in having any connection with him! When they have any object in view, they behave with courtesy. When that object is accomplished, they abandon the instrument.

sa: भीष्म उवाच दानशीलो भवेद् राजा यज्ञशीलश्च भारत। उपवासतप:शीलः प्रजानां पालने रतः॥
en: Bhishma said "The king should be liberal and should celebrate sacrifices, O Bharata. He should observe vows and penances, and should be devoted to the duty of protecting his subjects.

sa: तक्षेदात्मानमेवं स वनं परशुना यथा। यः सम्यग् वर्तमानेषु स्वेषु मिथ्या प्रवर्तते॥
en: That king, who treats deceitfully his own people that have not been guilty of any fault, cuts his own self like a person cutting down a forest with an axe.

sa: पुरा मङ्कणकः सिद्धः कुशाग्रेणेति नः श्रुतम्। क्षतः किल करे राजस्तस्य शाकरसोऽस्रवत॥
en: Formerly, after Mankanaka had become Successful, O king, his hand became pierced seven were with a Kusha blade. Thereupon a vegetable juice came out of the wound and not blood.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच निहते मामके सैन्ये निःशेषे शिबिरे कृते। पाण्डवानां बले सूतं किं नु शेषमभूत् तदा।॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When my soldiers were killed and our camp made entirely empty, what was the strength. O Suta, of the remnant the Pandavas army? 1 desire of know this. Therefore, tell me O Sanjaya, for you are a skillful narrator.

sa: ग्रावाण: शर्कराः कृत्वा प्रचक्रेऽभिषवं नृप। आज्यं च सलिलं चक्रे भागाश्च त्रिदिवौकसाम्॥
en: The pebbles lying there were converted into grains of sugar (in imagination) by Trita. He, then, O king, (mentally) performed his ablutions. He took the water for the clarified butter.

sa: इडोपहूताः क्रोशन्ति कुञ्जरास्त्वंकुशेरिताः। व्याघुश्तलनादेव वषट्कारेण पार्थिव॥ उद्गाता तत्र सग्रामे त्रिसामा दुन्दुभिर्नृप।
en: The cries of the elephant when urged on with hooks, form its Ida Mantras. The kettledrums, with the striking of palms forming the Vashats, O king, are its Trisaman Udgatri.

sa: कृप उवाच शुश्रूषुरपि दुर्मेधाः पुरुषोऽनियतेन्द्रियः। नालं वेदयितुं कृत्स्नौ धर्मार्थाविति मे मतिः॥
en: Kripa Said "A person who is not intelligent and who has not controlled, his passions, cannot, even if he waits dutifully upon his superiors, understand morality. This is my opinion.

sa: स संख्ये निधनं प्राप्य प्रशस्तं लोकपूजितम्। स्वधर्मं विपुलं प्राप्य शक्रस्येति सलोकताम्॥
en: Meeting with death in battle, he acquires great merit, fame and the respect of the world which belongs to his order and in the end lives with Indra in heaven.

sa: भीष्म उवाच यच्चरा ह्यचरानधुरंदष्ट्रान् दंष्ट्रिणस्तथा। आशीविषा इव क्रुद्धा भुजङ्गान् भुजगा इव॥
en: Bhishma said The mobile creatures devour things that are immobile; animals having teeth devour those that have none; angry snakes of dreadful venom devour smaller ones of their own species.

sa: सर्वत्र क्षेमचरणं सुलभं नाम गोमिषु। न ह्यतः सदृशं किंचिद् वरमस्ति युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: It is always easy to treat the Vaishyas kindly. There is nothing which does greater good to a kingdom, O. Yudhishthira, than such treatment of the Vaishyas of the kingdom.'

sa: अम्बरीषो हि नाभागिः स्वर्गं गत्वा सुदुर्लभम्। ददर्श सुरलोकस्थं शक्रेण सचिवं सह॥
en: Having gone to heaven that is so difficult of acquisition, Ambarisha, the son of Nabhaga, saw his own commander in chief in those celestial regions in the company of Indra.

sa: स मेघनिनदो हर्षनर्दन्निव न गोवृषः। आजुहाव ततः पार्थान् गदया युधि वीर्यवान्॥
en: With voice deep as the mutterings of the clouds or of a bull roaring in joy, the highly powerful Duryodhana then, armed with his mace, asked the Parthas for battle.

sa: विश्वामित्र उवाच अगस्त्येनासुरो जग्धो वातापिः क्षुधितेन वै। अहमापद्गतः क्षुत्तो भक्षयिष्ये श्वजाघनीम्॥
en: Vishvamitra said While hungry, the great Rishi Agastya ate up the Asura named Vatapi. I am in distress. I am hungry. I shall, therefore, eat that haunch of dog's meat.

sa: ऋचीक उवाच नैष संकल्पितः कामो मया भद्रे तथा त्वयि। उग्रकर्मा समुत्पन्नश्चरुव्यत्यासहेतुना॥
en: Richika said This was not intended by me, o blessed lady, for you. A son of terrific deeds has been conceived by you for the substitution of the sanctified food.

sa: न जातु बलवान् भूत्वा दुर्बले विश्वसेत् क्वचित्। भारुण्डसदृशा ह्येते निपतन्ति प्रमाद्यतः॥
en: The king, even if he be powerful, should trust the weak, for in moments of carelessness the weak may attack the powerful like a flock of vultures seizing their prey.

sa: स त्वं भीष्म महाबाहो वसूनां वासवोपमः। नित्यं विप्रैः समाख्यातो नवमोऽनवमो गुणैः॥
en: O mighty-armed Bhishma, you are described by the Brahinanas as the ninth of the Vasus. By your virtues, however, you have excelled them all and are equal to Vasava himself.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आर्तप्रलापान्मा तात सलिलस्थः प्रभाषिथा:। नैतन्मनसि मे राजन् वाशितं शकुनेरिव॥
en: Do not utter such ravings of sorrow, O sire, from within the lake. I do not, like Shakuni, feel any pity for you, O king, for such words as these.

sa: नान्यं देवादहं मन्ये रुद्रात परतरं महत्। सुरासुरस्य जगतो गति स्त्वमसि शूलधृत्॥
en: He understood the deity to be none else than Mahadeva. Filled with wonder he said-"I do not think that thou art any one save Rudra, the great and Supreme being.

sa: वैश्यस्यापि हि यो धर्मस्तं ते वक्ष्यामि शाश्वतम्। दानमध्ययनं यज्ञः शौचेन धनसंचयः॥
en: I shall now tell you, O Yudhishthira, what the eternal duties of the Vaishyas are.-A Vaishya should make gifts, study the Vedas, celebrate sacrifices, and acquire wealth by fair means.

sa: मनुष्यापसदा ह्येते ये भवन्ति पराङ्मुखा। राशिवर्धनमात्रास्ते नैव ते प्रेत्य नो इह॥
en: Those who retreat from battle are wretches among men. They simply increase the number of men. They will neither pass in this world nor in the next for true manhood.

sa: यदि दक्षः समारम्भात् कर्मणो नाश्नुते फलम्। नास्य वाच्यं भवेत् किंचिल्लब्धव्यं वाधिगच्छति॥
en: If an active man succeeds in gaining his object or fails to obtain the fruit of his acts, he does not become the but of censure in any way. one

sa: न हि पश्यामि जीवन्तं लोके कञ्चिदहिंसया। सत्त्वैः सत्त्वा हि जीवन्ति दुर्बलैर्बलवत्तराः॥
en: I do not see any such creature in this world that supports life without doing any act of injury to others. Animals live upon animals, the stronger upon the weaker.

sa: रणे कर्णे हते वीरे त्रासिता जितकाशिभिः। नालभशर्म ते पुत्रा हिमवन्तमृते गिरिम्॥
en: After the heroic Karna has been killed in battle, your sons, filled with fear by the Pandavas desirous of victory, did not obtain peace anywhere else than on the Himavat.

sa: भीष्म उवाच राज्ञा पुरोहितः कार्यो भवेद् विद्वान् बहुश्रुतः। उभौ समीक्ष्य धर्मार्थावप्रमेयावनन्तरम्॥
en: Bhishma said The king, observing both religious merit and profit which are very intricate, should, forthwith, appoint a priest learned and acquainted intimately with the Vedas and the (other) scriptures.

sa: पुत्रमस्यानयत् क्षिप्रं तपसा च श्रुतेन च। स समानीय तत्पुत्रं तमुपालभ्य पार्थिवम्॥
en: Having caused the prince to be brought there, the sage remonstrated with the king (his father). That foremost of virtuous persons then showed himself to be the god of righteousness.

sa: आभ्यन्तरं भयं रक्ष्यमसारं बाह्यतो भयम्॥ आभ्यन्तरं भयं राजन् सद्यो मूलानि कृन्तति।
en: Protect yourself, O king, from all internal fears. External fears, however, are not very important. The first kind of fear, O king, may cut your roots in a single day.

sa: पाङ्गद्धण्यं त्रिवर्गं च त्रिवर्गपरमं तथा। यो वेत्ति पुरुषव्याघ्र स भुक्कते पृथिवीमिमाम्॥
en: That king, O foremost of man, who is conversant with the collection of six and three objects, and the high collection of three, gains the sovereignty of the whole Earth.

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य संरब्धममितौजसम्। मोघमस्य प्रहारं तं चिकीर्षुर्भरतर्षभ॥ अवस्थाने मतिं कृत्वा पुत्रस्तव महामनाः। इयेषोत्पतितुं राजञ्छलयिष्यन् वृकोदरम्॥
en: Seeing the energetic Bhimasena, filled with rage and rushing towards him your high-souled so, O Bharata's chief, desiring to thwart his blow, thought of showing the manoeuvre called Avasthana. He, therefore, desired to jump upwards, O king, king, for beguiling Vrikodara.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच धार्मिकोऽर्थानसम्प्राप्य राजामात्यैः प्रबाधितः। च्युतः कोशाच्च दण्डाच्च सुखमिच्छन् कथं चरेत्॥
en: How should a righteous king, who is proposed by his own officers whose treasury and army are not under his control, and who has no wealth, act for acquiring happiness?"

sa: एष वृद्धः पराँल्लोकान् सम्प्राप्नोति तनुं त्यजन्। तं शीघ्रमनुयुजीध्वं संशयान् मनसि स्थितान्॥
en: Aged as he is, after renouncing his corporeal frame he will attain to high regions of bliss. Request him, therefore, forthwith to clear the doubts that exist in your minds.

sa: आसी-मैत्री तु तावन्नौ यावद्धतुरभूत् पुरा॥ सा गता सह तेनैव कालयुक्तेन हेतुना।
en: There was friendship between us as long as there was necessity for the same. That reason, the outcome of time, is gone. Without it, that friendship also has passed away.

sa: इति चाप्यत्र कौन्तेय मन्त्रो वेदेषु पठ्यते। वेदप्रमाणविहितं धर्मं च प्रब्रवीमि ते॥
en: There is a Mantra in the Vedas, O son of Kunti, that sanctions it, I describe to you only those practices which are sanctioned by the authority of the Vedas.

sa: संजय उवाच वार्तिकाणां सकाशात् तु श्रुत्वा दुर्योधनं हतम्। हतशिष्टास्ततो राजन् कौरवाणां महारथाः॥ विनिर्भिन्नाः शितैर्बाणैर्गदातोमरशक्तिभिः। अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः॥ त्वरिता जवनैरश्वैरायोधनमुपागमन्। तत्रापश्यन् महात्मानं धार्तराष्ट्र निपातितम्॥ प्रभग्नं वायुवेगेन महाशालं यथा वने। भूमौ विचेष्टमानं तं रुधिरेण समुक्षितम्॥ महागजमिवारण्ये व्याधेन विनिपातितम्। विवर्तमानं वहुशो रुधिरौधपरिप्लुतम्॥
en: Sanjaya said “Having heard of Duryodhana's fall from the messengers, those powerful car-warriors, the remnant of the Kaurava arıny greatly wounded with keen arrows and maces and lances and darts-those three, viz.. Ashvathaman and Kripa and Kritavarman of the Satwata race, riding at breakneck pace on their swift chargers came to the field of battle. They saw there the high-souled son of Dhritarashtra lying low on the ground, like a gigantic Shala tree laid low in the forest by a storm. They saw him suffering on the mother Earth and covered with blood like a powerful elephant in the forest laid low by a hunter. They saw him suffering and bleeding profusely.

sa: क्रोधो भेदो भयं दण्डः कर्षणं निग्रहो वधः। नयत्यरिवशं सद्यो गणान् भरतसत्तम॥
en: King's anger, disunion with him, terror, punishment, persecution, oppression, and executions, O chief of the Bharatas, quickly alienate the aristocracy from the king and make them side with kings' enemies.

sa: नमस्ते भगवन् विष्णो लोकानां प्रभवाप्यया त्वं हि कर्ता हृषीकेश संहर्ता चापराजितः॥
en: Salutations to you. O divine Lord, O Vishnu, and, O eternal origin of all the worlds. You, O Hrishikesha, are the Creator, you are the Destroyer, and you are invincible.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ब्राह्मणस्य तु चत्वारस्त्वाश्रमा विहिताः प्रभो। वर्णास्तान् नानुवर्तन्ते त्रयो भारतसत्तम॥
en: Bhishma said ‘The four modes of life, O powerful one, have been laid down for the Brahmana. The other three orders do not adopt them, O best of the Bharatas.

sa: यात्रायां यदि विज्ञातमनाक्रन्दमनन्तरम्। व्यासक्तं च प्रमत्तं च दुर्बलं च विचक्षणः॥ यात्रामाज्ञापयेद् वीरः कल्यः पुष्टबलः सुखी। पूर्वं कृत्वा विधानं च यात्रायां नगरे तथा॥
en: As regards military operations, a king, who knows his own strength, should, commanding a large army cheerfully and courageously give the order to march, without announcing his destination, against one shorn of allies and friends or already at war with another and hence careless or one weaker than himself, having first made arrangements for the protection of his own city.

sa: व्यास उवाच अकुर्वन् विहितं कर्म प्रतिषिद्धानि चाचरन्। प्रायश्चित्तीयते ह्येवं नरो मिथ्यानुवर्तयन्॥
en: Vyasa said “Having omitted to perform those acts that have been ordained, and done those that have been forbidden, and have behaved deceitfully, a man becomes liable to perform expiation.

sa: न तन्मनसि कर्तव्यं न च तद् द्रौणिना कृतम्। महादेवप्रसादेन कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम्॥
en: You should not think of it. It was not Drona's son that performed that act. It was done through the power of Mahadeva. Do now what should be done next."

sa: व्याघ्रचर्मोत्तरे शुक्ले सर्वतोभद्र आसने। दृढपादप्रतिष्ठाने हुताशनसमत्विषि॥ उपवेश्य महात्मानं कृष्णां च दुपदात्मजाम्। जुहाव पावकं धीमान् विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम्॥
en: Making the great Yudhishthira then, with Krishna the daughter of Drupada, seated upon a handsome seat, called Sarvatobhadra, with firm feet and covered with tiger-skin and effulgent, began to pour libations of clarified butter upon the sacrificial fire with proper Mantras.

sa: तमुत्तङ्क उपाध्यायं प्रत्युवाच भोस्तक्षकेण मे नागराजेन विघ्नः कृतोऽस्मिन्कर्मणि तेनाऽस्मि नागलोकं गतः॥
en: Uttanka replied to the preceptor, “The king of the Nagas, Takshaka, offered obstruction to the business I went and therefore I had to go to the land of the Nagas.

sa: तत्कालसमये चैव दक्षयज्ञो बभूव ह॥ न चैवाकल्पयद् भागं दक्षो रुद्रस्य भारत।
en: At that time the great sacrifice of Daksha took place. Daksha, however, in that sacrifice of his, refused to dedicate a share to Rudra, O Bharata, of the sacrificial offerings.

sa: ततस्तथेत्येवमुदारदर्शनः प्रतीतरूपो भरतोऽब्रवीद् वचः। चकार बुद्धिं च तदाश्रमे तदा निशानिवासाय नराधिपात्मजः॥
en: Thereat the gently-looking and highly famous one said, “Be it so;" and the king's son made up his mind to spend the night in the great hermitage (of the saint).

sa: न पद्भ्यां स्पृशते भूमिं न च शूलं विमुञ्चति। शूलाच्छूलसहस्राणि निष्पेतुस्तस्य तेजसा॥
en: He never touches the earth with his feet nor does he hurled his trident; but in consequence of his energy, thousands of arrows issue out of that trident of his.

sa: अदृष्टतोऽनुपायाच्च प्रतिसंधेश्च कर्मणः। न तेन माः पश्यन्ति येन गच्छन्ति तत् पदम्॥
en: Through unfavourable destiny, through inability to find out the proper expedient, and through the obstacles put in by acts, men cannot see the path by which Brahına may be reached.

sa: एष देवकृतो मार्गः सेवितव्यः सदा नरैः॥ अकघायकृतश्चैव मार्ग: सेव्यः सदा वुधैः।
en: Those men who are devoted to their own wives and who seek them in only their seasons, and who do not indulge in sexual pleasure, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

sa: नास्त्यण्डमस्ति तु ब्रह्मा स राजा लोकभावनः। इत्युक्तः स तदा तूष्णीमभूद् वायुस्ततोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: There is no Egg. Brahman, however, is existent. He is the Creator of the universe and is its King! Thus addressed by the god of wind, king Arjuna remained silent.

sa: अर्धकीलं च तत्रैव तीर्थं कुरुकुलोद्वह॥ विप्राणामनुकम्पार्थं दर्भिणा निर्मितं पुरा। व्रतोपनयनाभ्यां चाप्युपवासेन वाप्युत॥ क्रियामन्त्रैश्च संयुक्तो ब्राह्मणः स्यान्न संशयः। क्रियामन्त्रविहीनोऽपि तत्र स्नात्वा नरर्षभा चीर्णव्रतो भवेद् विद्वान् दृष्टमेतत् पुरातनैः॥
en: O perpetuator of the Kuru race, there is another Tirtha, called Ardhakila. Darbhi created it in the days of yore from compassion for the Brahmans. By vows, by taking the sacred thread, by lasts. By rites and by Mantras, one certainly becomes a Brahman. ) foremost of inen, it has been seen by the ancients that by bathing there, men learned and are endued with the fruits of observing the VOWS.

sa: स्मृतिस्त्वेनं न हि जहौ तदा नारायणाज्ञया। देवास्तु सहिताः सर्वे वसोः शापविमोक्षणम्॥
en: To the good fortune of Vasu, the gods, pained at the curse imprecated on him by the Brahmanas, began to think anxiously as to how that curse might be removed.

sa: वृक्षैः सशाखैः शिखरैर्वज्रकोटिनिभै खैः॥ मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिः पद्भिर्बाहुभिश्च पुनः पुनः। तयोर्युद्धमभूद्घोरं वृत्रवासवयोरिव ॥
en: Thereupon there took place a mighty conflict between them like to Vitra and Vāsava by means of trees with branches, hills, nails, hard as thunderbolts, fists, knees, legs and arms.

sa: बृहस्पतिरुवाच राजमूलो महाप्राज्ञ धर्मो लोकस्य लक्ष्यते। प्रजा राजभयादेव न खादन्ति परस्परम्॥
en: Brihaspati said The duties of all men, you of great wisdom, originate from the king. It is through fear of the king only that men do not devour one another.

sa: न हि बाणा मयोत्सृष्टाः सज्जन्तीह शरीरिणाम्। कायेषु विदितं तुभ्यं पुरा क्षत्रियसंगरे॥
en: The arrows, shot forth by me, do not stick in the body of living creatures (but pass clearly through them); it is known to you in the with the Kshatriyas.

sa: आर्यव्रतश्च पाञ्चाल्यो न स राजा धनप्रियः। न संत्यक्ष्यति कौन्तेयान् राज्यदानैरपि ध्रुवम्॥
en: The Panchala king is honest and virtuous, he is not covetous for wealth. Even if we offer him our whole kingdom, he will certainly not abandon the sons of Kunti.

sa: भोजयित्वा द्विजान् कामैः संतर्घ्य च महाधनैः॥ प्रययौ सहितो विप्रैः स्तूयमानश्च माधवः।
en: And feeding many Brahmanas and satisfying them with many rich gifts as desired by them, Baladeva, of Madhu's race, left that place accompanied by many Brahmanas and praised by them.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा नृपश्रेष्ठो धार्तराष्ट्रो विशाम्पते। आज्ञापयामास नृपः क्रतुराजप्रवर्तनम्॥ ततः प्रववृते यज्ञः प्रभूतार्थः सुसंस्कृतः। दीक्षितश्चापि गान्धारिर्यथाशास्त्रं यथाक्रमम्॥
en: O king, having heard this, that foremost of kings, Dhritarashtra's son commanded that foremost of sacrifices to be commenced. Then commenced that sacrifice sanctified by mantras and abounding in food. The son of Gandhari was duly installed according to the ordinance.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच वाचस्तीक्ष्णास्थिभेदिन्यः सूतपुत्रेण भाषिताः। अतितीव्रा मया क्षान्तास्तेन प्राप्ताः स्म संशयम्॥
en: Arjuna said: As I did not present those very sharp and biting words, piercing the very bones, uttered by the son of Suta, so we have met with this calamity.

sa: राजप्रेष्यं कृषिधनं जीवनं च वणिक्पथा। कौटिल्यं कौलटेयं च कुसीदं च विवर्जयेत्॥
en: A Brahmana should avoid service of the king, money obtained by agriculture, sustenance derived from the trade, all kinds of wily conduct, knowing any but his married wives and usury.

sa: ततो मुहूर्तादिव पार्थिवेन्द्रो लब्ध्वा संज्ञां क्रोधसंरक्तनेत्रः। शतेन पार्थं त्वरितो जघान सहस्रनेत्रप्रतिमप्रभावः॥
en: Regaining his consciousness within a moment that foremost of kings viz., Shalya, powerful like Indra with eyes reddened in wrath, quickly struck the son of Pritha with a hundred arrows.

sa: उत्तिष्ठ हे कापुरुष मा शेष्वैवं पराजितः। अमित्रान् नन्दयन् सर्वान् निर्मानो बन्धुशोकदः॥
en: Rise, O coward, do not remain inactive in this way being defeated, thereby increasing the joys of our enemies, affording cause for grief to your friends and regardless of everything.

sa: जनक उवाच कतीन्द्रियाणि विप्रर्षे कति प्रकृतयः स्मृताः। किमव्यक्तं परं ब्रह्म तस्माच्च परतस्तु किम्॥ प्रभवं चाप्ययं चैव कालसंख्यां तथैव च। वक्तुमर्हसि विप्रेन्द्र त्वदनुग्रहकाङ्क्षिणः॥
en: Janaka said ( regenerate Rishi, how many kinds of senses are there? How many kinds also are there of Nature? What is the Unmanifest and highest Brahma? What is higher than Brahmana? What is Birth and what Death? What are the limits of Age? You should, O foremost of Brahmanas, describe all these subjects to me who seek your favour.

sa: अनन्यभावामनुरक्तचेतसं त्वया वियुक्तां मरणाय निश्चिताम्। नयस्व मां साधु कुरुष्व याचनां नातो मया ते गुरुता भविष्यति॥
en: Do you accept my entreaty whose heart is entirely yours, knows none else, and is ever attached to you, and who am resolved to die if forsaken by you; thus repairing I shall be in no way a burden to you.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच अद्य तान् कुशलैर्विप्रैः सुगुप्तैराप्तकारिभिः। कुन्तीपुत्रान् भेदयामो माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ॥
en: Duryodhana said : Let us by the help of trusted and skillful Brahmanas privately create dissensions amongst the Pandavas, a quarrel between the sons of Kunti and those of Madri.

sa: याः स्म ता लोकनाथेन नाथवन्त्यः पुराभवन्। तास्त्वनाथास्तदा नाथं पार्थं दृष्ट्वा विचुक्रुशुः॥
en: Those ladies who had, before this, the very Lord of the universe for their protector, were now lordless. Seeing that Partha, had come for protecting them, they all bewailed aloud.

sa: मुमूर्षुर्हि नरः सर्वान् वृक्षान् पश्यति काञ्चनान्। तथा त्वमपि गान्धारे विपरीतानि पश्यसि॥
en: A man on the brink of death sees everything to be made of gold; so also, O son of Gandhari, you see everything to be invested with a yellow hue.

sa: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा भूतपूर्वं न किल्बिषम्। तस्याहं फलमश्नामि अपापा मैथिली यदि॥
en: I have never perpetrated before a crime either, in my mind, body, or speech. If Maithili is found divested of sin I may then partake of the fruits of piety.

sa: ब्रूयाः कर्ण इतो गत्वा द्रोणं शान्तनवं कृपम्। सौम्योऽयं वर्तते मासः सुप्रापयवसेन्धनः॥
en: Going from here, O Karna, tell Drona, the son of Shantanu and Kripa that the present month is a charming one with plenty of food, drink and fuel. a car

sa: सोढं तत् परमं दुःखं मया कालप्रतीक्षया। सोऽयमभ्यागतः कालो भविता मे सुखोदयः॥
en: I have suffered these great pangs and I wait for the time (when it will be assuaged). That time has now come, when I expect that my happiness would come.

sa: संद्राव्यमाणं तु बलं परेषां परीतकल्पं विबभौ समन्ततः। नैवावतस्थे समरे भृशं भयाद् विमृद्यमानं तु परस्परं तदा॥
en: The army so driven by thai elephant seemed as if trapped from all sides. It could not stay for moments in the battle-field on account of sheer fright. All soldiers started crushing in hue and cry over mutual pull and push.

sa: पुराणि दग्धवन्तं तं देवी याता प्रवीक्षितुम्॥ बालमङ्कगतं कृत्वा स्वयं पञ्चशिखं पुनः।
en: When the tripple city began to burn, the goddess Durga went to see the sight, with a child on her lap having only five clumps of hair on its head.

sa: न संनिपातः कर्तव्यः सामान्ये विजये सति। विश्वास्यैवोपसन्नार्थो वशे कृत्वा रिपुः प्रभो॥
en: When victory may be achieved by either side, a hostile collision of arms should be avoided. Having made an enemy feel security, one should subdue him and active one's end.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ता बहुविधं सान्त्वपूर्वं विवस्वता। सा तु नैच्छद्वरारोहा कन्याहमिति भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Vivasvat thus spoke to her many things to allay her fears. O descendant of the Bharata race, the illustrious and beautiful girl, as she was a maid.

sa: पाण्डवीं समरे सेनां सम्ममर्द स कुञ्जरः। यथा वनगजो राजन् मृनश्चरति पद्मिनीम्॥
en: Bhagadatta riding on his elephants crushed in that battle, the troops of the Pandavas, even like a wild elephants, that roves, O king, trampling lotus stems (underneath its huge feet).

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमेष नृपः पापः शिशुपालः सुमन्दधीः। त्वां समाह्वयते वीर गोविन्दवरदर्पितः॥
en: Bhishma said. O Bhima, such is this wretch Shishupala, a king with a wicked heart. Being proud for the boon granted by Govinda (Krishna), he now calls you to battle.

sa: नागायुतबलो मानी तेजसा न स मानुषः। माद्रीपुत्रौ च रथिनौ द्वावेष पुरुषर्षभौ॥
en: Filled with pride and endued with the strength of ten thousand elephants he is not human is energy; the two foremost among men, the sons of Madri, are two Rathas.
